title: Cancellation
description: Cancellation metadata: when and by whom something was canceled, an optional reason, and when the cancellation was acknowledged.

canceled_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this package was canceled.

canceled_by.description: Which party initiated the package cancellation.

acknowledged_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the seller acknowledged the cancellation. Confirms inventory has been released and billing stopped. Absent until the seller processes the cancellation.
